validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table read by eye from 200-dpi crops of the right-hand half of each spread (bottoms re-cropped where a table runs to the page foot), tesseract as cross-check only. Numerical index read in full by eye (4 half-page images), typed out and compared with the transcription in both directions on part number, page and ref.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except printed gaps: transaxle 1212H refs 11, 50, 62; transaxle 1212G refs 16, 19, 24, 63; flywheel/stator refs 2, 6. Repeated refs (options as printed): fender 18 (1212H/1212G cover), electrical 9 (nut, cap), decals 4/5/10/14/16 (1212H/1212G), steering 34/35 (R.H./L.H.), transaxle 1212H 28 and 49 (washer options), transaxle 1212G 53 then 53A, engine block 9, 18, 19, 21, 22, starter 1, 2, 5, 7. Rows with no ref number stored as ref 0: motion drive C40894, transaxle 1212H assembly C40675, hydrostatic pump (C35405, C35546, C35411, C40895), steering tire-assembly sub-items (3), engine block gasket set, carburetor kits (2).
validation.quantities: All rows have a qty except clutch refs 25 (VALVE - air) and 27 (TIRE **), and the two carburetor kits C40870/C40878 (flagged "no qty printed"). 9 rows are UAR. No REQ'D column is out of register.
validation.numericalIndex: 718 index entries (part, page, ref) read by eye and compared row by row against the transcription, both directions: all match except the items listed in the issues file. Index vs table differences, all decided by the user 2026-11-17: C34496 used (table C24496) 33/18; table kept: C27258 (index C37259) 43/5, C35303 (index C34303) 23/5, C39506 (index C39056) 5/18, C29620 (index C39620) 9/9 and 9/19, 195-518 ref 36 (index lists it at ref 33). Not in the index: C40877 (39/27), kits C40870 and C40878, C40894 (13), C40895 and C35411 (31, not shown); paint and oil are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (93630), Case letter prefixes closed up (C40714), hardware codes stored NNN-NNNN (113-102); printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted. O/L (obtain locally) on air cleaner refs 2, 3, 8, 11 stored as O/L with no source.
